title: More reasoning catches more backdoors without raising false alarms
caption: Top: backdoors caught at a 2% audit budget at each reasoning setting, with 95% intervals. Bottom: share of the 500 clean programs the same monitors score at or above the dial's level, same colours. Detection rises by up to 28 points while false alarms stay near zero.
notes: Paired by program, lowest against highest effort, no model's false alarms rose significantly at any of the three levels. The biggest change at 5 or more is one program in 500.
At a fixed budget the flagged share of clean code is fixed by design, so the bottom panel uses absolute score levels. That is what shows clean code isn't scored as more suspicious.
Not every model gains: Gemini Flash-Lite catches fewer backdoors as effort rises and Mistral Large 4 is flat (P03). Neither raises false alarms either.
One run per setting. Sonnet high and Haiku xhigh replicate on the second 500 problems.
